name: P2P
tagline: Turning supplier invoices into matched, approved and settled payments with a controlled month-end close.
pickerIntro: Twelve accounts payable processes from goods receipt and invoice capture through matching, approval, payment and month-end control.

context.label: Solutions
context.text: A Green Belt project (live Q4 2025) auto-maps Kofax data into Coupa and enables multi-bank selection; Xelix duplicate monitoring, a Taiwan non-VAT monitoring change and a tax process redesign with Global C&B are also documented.

context.label: Automation
context.text: Kofax OCR captures invoices into Coupa, approved iPay down payments post automatically to SAP, and Coupa and iPay invoices post to SAP by interface. Reconciliation, follow-up and interface cut-off automation remain open CI items.

context.label: AI
context.text: No deployed AI capability is documented in the current process inventory.

context.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
context.text: AP works with suppliers, requestors and business approvers on invoice data and approvals, with IT and OpsIT on interface errors, with TDT on withholding tax, and with C&B and Global C&B on bank execution and tax payments.

processes.title: Goods receipt and service confirmation
processes.purpose:
Record the physical or virtual receipt of direct materials and services against the purchase order, including quantity, batch and expiry details. The receipt is the evidence that goods or services have arrived as ordered.

The goods receipt enables three-way invoice matching in Coupa. If the receipt is late or does not reach Coupa, the supplier invoice cannot be matched and stalls in Pending Receipt status, so receipts must also be corrected when the SAP-to-Coupa integration fails.
processes.purposeSummary: Record **goods receipts and service confirmations** against purchase orders so invoices can be **three-way matched** in Coupa.
processes.cadenceSummary: **Timing and frequency are not specified** in the supplied file.

stages.title: Record the goods receipt against the PO
stages.displayTitle: Record the goods receipt against the PO
stages.detail: Record physical or virtual receipt of direct materials and services against the PO
stages.description: Record the physical or virtual receipt of direct materials and services in SAP against the purchase order once the goods or services have been received.

stages.title: Capture quantity, batch and expiry details
stages.displayTitle: Capture quantity, batch and expiry details
stages.detail: including quantity, batch and expiry details.
stages.description: Enter the quantity received together with batch and expiry details as part of the receipt, so that the record reflects exactly what was delivered.

stages.title: Make the receipt available for three-way matching
stages.displayTitle: Make the receipt available for three-way matching
stages.detail: The receipt enables 3-way invoice matching
stages.description:
The posted receipt flows to Coupa, where it enables three-way matching of the supplier invoice against the purchase order and the receipt.

Where the receipt is delayed, the invoice cannot be matched and remains in Pending Receipt status in Coupa until the receipt is recorded.
challenges: Delay in goods receipt results in the invoice being stuck in Pending Receipt status during the invoice processing stage in Coupa.

stages.title: Correct receipts when the SAP-to-Coupa integration fails
stages.displayTitle: Correct receipts when the SAP-to-Coupa integration fails
stages.detail: must be corrected when SAP-to-Coupa integration fails.
stages.description: When the SAP-to-Coupa integration fails, correct the receipt so that the matching record in Coupa is complete and the invoice can proceed.

challenges: Delay in goods receipt results in the invoice being stuck in Pending Receipt status during the invoice processing stage in Coupa.

stages.description:
Route verified PO and non-PO invoices from iPay to Coupa for matching, approval and export to SAP.

processes.title: Coupa invoice matching and holds
processes.purpose:
Match invoices in Coupa against the purchase order (two-way) or the purchase order and goods receipt (three-way), and work the invoices that fall into Draft, AP Hold, On Hold, Pending Action, Pending Receipt or Booking Hold status.

Clearing these statuses involves completing missing fields, applying split accounting and WHT or tax codes, selecting remit-to details, and obtaining the goods receipt or approvals that are outstanding, so that valid invoices can be released into the approval flow.
processes.cadence: AP sends a weekly reminder to follow up on pending split-accounting action items. No other timing is stated.
processes.purposeSummary: Perform **two-way or three-way matching** in Coupa and clear **Draft, hold and pending statuses** so valid invoices can be released.
processes.cadenceSummary: **Weekly reminders** are sent for pending split-accounting actions; other timing and frequency are not specified in the supplied file.

stages.displayTitle: Perform two-way or three-way matching
stages.detail: Perform 2-way or 3-way matching
stages.description:
Match each invoice in Coupa against the purchase order (two-way) or against the purchase order and the goods receipt (three-way).

Where the match falls outside tolerance, the invoice is not routed to the user's queue, so AP follows up manually with the user to resolve the difference.
challenges: Review tolerance issue: in most cases this requires manual follow-up with the user, as the invoice is not routed to the user's queue.

stages.title: Clear Pending Action items with requestors

stages.detail: Pending Action; split accounting. Split Accounting:: AP will monitor the comments, upload the split accounting template on behalf of the requester, and send weekly reminder to follow up on any pending action items.
stages.description: Follow up invoices in Pending Action status with the requestor. Where split accounting is needed, AP monitors the invoice comments, uploads the split accounting template on behalf of the requester and sends a weekly reminder until the pending action is completed.

stages.description: Once the invoice is matched and all holds are cleared, release the valid invoice so that it proceeds to approval and export.

Split accounting: AP monitors the comments, uploads the split accounting template on behalf of the requester, and sends a weekly reminder to follow up on any pending action items.

processes.title: Invoice exception handling
processes.purpose:
Handle invoices that cannot follow the standard electronic path. Invoices are corrected before approval, or handled with linked credit notes and corrected copies after approval. Invalid invoices are disputed from any eligible status and the resolution is coordinated with the supplier or requestor. Manual invoice creation is used only when standard electronic processing is unavailable.

The Actual Invoice Receipt (AIR) process covers Korea, where a manual adjustment is required when the actual invoice is issued with or without tax. The user attaches the actual invoice in the Coupa comment section and AP reviews and processes it.
processes.purposeSummary: Correct, dispute or manually create **exception invoices** and process **actual invoice receipt (AIR)** adjustments.
processes.cadenceSummary: **Timing and frequency are not specified** in the supplied file.

stages.displayTitle: Correct invoices before approval
stages.detail: Correct invoices before approval
stages.description: Where an error is found on an invoice that has not yet been approved, correct the invoice directly in Coupa so that it can continue through matching and approval.

stages.title: Correct approved invoices via credit notes
stages.displayTitle: Correct approved invoices via credit notes
stages.detail: Correcting Approved Invoices; use linked credit notes and corrected copies after approval.
stages.description: Once an invoice has been approved it is not edited. Instead, a linked credit note from the supplier and a corrected copy of the invoice are processed to put the correct values in place.

stages.title: Dispute invalid invoices and coordinate resolution
stages.displayTitle: Dispute invalid invoices and coordinate resolution
stages.detail: Dispute Invoice; Invoice Discrepancy & Resolution Follow Up; Dispute invalid invoices from any eligible status, coordinate supplier or requestor resolution
stages.description: Dispute an invalid invoice from any eligible Coupa status and follow up the discrepancy with the supplier or the requestor until it is resolved.

stages.title: Create manual invoices as an exception
stages.displayTitle: Create manual invoices as an exception
stages.detail: Creating Manual Invoices; handle exceptional manual creation only when standard electronic processing is unavailable.
stages.description: As an exception, create the invoice manually only when standard electronic processing is not available.

stages.title: Process actual invoice receipt (AIR) adjustments
stages.displayTitle: Process actual invoice receipt (AIR) adjustments
stages.detail: AIR process - Manual adjustment is required when actual invoice issued with tax/without tax (KR).  User will attach in Coupa comment section, AP will then review and process.
stages.description:
For Korea, a manual adjustment is required when the actual invoice is issued with or without tax. The user attaches the actual invoice in the Coupa comment section, and AP reviews the attachment, processes the adjustment and updates the invoice number in both Coupa and SAP.

After the adjustment, AP monitors the transaction and performs the required clearing to avoid double payment or duplicate posting.
challenges: AIR process: manual adjustments create a risk of double payment or duplicate posting if AP does not effectively monitor the transaction and perform the required clearing after the adjustment. In addition, reviewing invoices that have no VAT impact is a non-value-added activity for AP, since the purpose is only to update the invoice number in both Coupa and SAP.

AIR process: manual adjustments create a risk of double payment or duplicate posting if AP does not effectively monitor the transaction and perform the required clearing after the adjustment. In addition, reviewing invoices that have no VAT impact is a non-value-added activity for AP, since the purpose is only to update the invoice number in both Coupa and SAP.
improvements: Documented improvements: For Taiwan, effective July, AP has aligned with users to stop monitoring actual invoices that have no VAT impact. Comments will be standardised to distinguish VAT from non-VAT invoices, and non-VAT invoices will be excluded from the monitoring report, with estimated time savings of 100 hours annually. This approach cannot be applied in Korea and Vietnam because local VAT reporting requires the invoice number to be updated for reconciliation.

processes.title: SAP posting and interface exceptions
processes.purpose:
Monitor the automated posting of approved invoices from iPay, Coupa and other approved source systems into SAP, and manage the exceptions when a posting or interface fails.

Errors are resolved by resetting and re-exporting the invoice where appropriate, or by raising an IT ticket. When the automation cannot be restored, the invoice is posted manually in SAP under control and the SAP document references are updated in the source system.

processes.title: Down-payment and non-invoice payments
processes.purpose:
Process down payments, pre-payments and non-invoice payment requests raised in Coupa. Down and pre-payments require additional approvals in Coupa based on the payment value, in line with the P2P Downpayment Approver Matrix, and are then posted manually in SAP.

Non-invoice payments are requested through the Coupa payment form, with the split account template used where the payment needs to be assigned to multiple cost objects.
processes.purposeSummary: Approve **down payments and non-invoice payment requests** in Coupa under the **Downpayment Approver Matrix** and post them manually in SAP.
processes.cadenceSummary: **Timing and frequency are not specified** in the supplied file.

stages.title: Submit the payment request in Coupa
stages.displayTitle: Submit the payment request in Coupa
stages.detail: Non Invoice payment form request via Coupa. Split account template used if multiple cost assignments needed.
stages.description: The requestor raises the down payment, pre-payment or non-invoice payment request in Coupa using the payment form. Where the amount needs to be assigned to multiple cost objects, the split account template is attached.

stages.title: Review the value against the Downpayment Approver Matrix
stages.displayTitle: Review the value against the Downpayment Approver Matrix
stages.detail: Down/ pre-payment requires additional approvals in Coupa based on the payment value aligned with P2P Downpayment Approver Matrix. The processor must review the amount and determine whether additional approval is required in accordance with the DP matrix.
stages.description: The AP processor reviews the payment value and determines, in accordance with the P2P Downpayment Approver Matrix, whether additional approval is required beyond the standard Coupa approval chain.
challenges: Pre/down payment: the processor must review the amount and determine whether additional approval is required in accordance with the DP matrix. If additional approval is needed, the approver must be added manually, and the posting can only proceed once all required approvals have been obtained.

stages.title: Add approvers and obtain the required approvals
stages.displayTitle: Add approvers and obtain the required approvals
stages.owner: AP; Line manager; Finance / DoA approvers
stages.detail: If additional approval is needed, the approver must be added manually, and the posting can only proceed once all required approvals have been obtained.
stages.description: If additional approval is needed, AP adds the approver to the Coupa request manually. The line manager and the Finance or DoA approvers then approve the request. Posting cannot proceed until all required approvals have been obtained.

stages.title: Post the down payment manually in SAP
stages.displayTitle: Post the down payment manually in SAP
stages.detail: and manually post them in SAP.
stages.description: Once fully approved, AP posts the down payment or pre-payment manually in SAP so that it can be included in the payment run.

challenges: Pre/down payment: the processor must review the amount and determine whether additional approval is required in accordance with the DP matrix. If additional approval is needed, the approver must be added manually, and the posting can only proceed once all required approvals have been obtained.
